cases.sentence: А из их братьев, сыновей Мерари — с ___:
cases.explain: «левой стороны» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

cases.sentence: Их братьям-левитам были поручены все ___ при доме Божьем.
cases.explain: «прочие обязанности» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

cases.sentence: Вот места их поселений, выделенные им в надел (они достались потомкам Аарона из клана Каафа, потому что им выпал ___).
cases.explain: «первый жребий» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

cases.sentence: ___ Каафа по жребию получили десять городов от половины рода Манассии.
cases.explain: «Остальные потомки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

cases.sentence: Некоторые из ___ получили в надел города от рода Ефрема.
cases.explain: «каафитских кланов» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

cases.sentence: А из надела половины рода Манассии израильтяне дали остальным ___ Анер и Билеам с их пастбищами.
cases.explain: «каафитским кланам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

cases.explain: «Остальные мерариты» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, Tabor with its pasture lands;
